name: The Legend of Astera Stone
source:
An inexperienced mage and a grumpy vampire hunter - there is no better dream team! The Mage Academy has put together a team of two (reluctant) specialists: Astera Carras, who specializes in all things magic, and Hunter Falke, who is a poor but excellent vampire hunter. Together they must retrieve a stolen magic artifact from Vincent von Hass's castle. How will the dream team fare? Do the misunderstandings and mishaps in communication ruin the whole mission? The castle awaits...

[From [URL=https://ebbasuke.itch.io/the-legend-of-astera-stone]Itch.io[/URL]]
translation:
一位经验不足的法师，加上一位脾气暴躁的吸血鬼猎人——还有比这更棒的梦幻组合吗？法师学院把两位不情不愿的专家凑成一队：精通各类魔法的阿斯特拉·卡拉斯，以及贫穷却技艺出众的吸血鬼猎人亨特·法尔克。他们必须携手，从文森特·冯·哈斯的城堡中取回一件被盗的魔法遗物。这对梦幻搭档会表现如何？接连不断的误会和沟通失误，会让整场任务彻底泡汤吗？城堡正等待着他们…

[摘自[URL=https://ebbasuke.itch.io/the-legend-of-astera-stone]itch.io[/URL]]
